name: Virginia Industrial Plastics

about:
Virginia Industrial Plastics, Inc. (VIP) is a family-run plastic thermoforming and fabrication company based in Elkton, Virginia. For over 40 years it has provided contract manufacturing services from its plant there, producing made-in-the-USA parts for a range of industrial and commercial customers.

The company specializes in heavy-gauge thermoforming and vacuum forming, complemented by CNC trimming and CNC cutting from sheet stock. It builds its own tooling, molds, and fixtures, and offers value-added assembly, just-in-time inventory management, product design support, and material specification guidance. VIP also provides turnkey services that cover the full cycle from tooling through assembly, packaging, and shipping.

VIP serves markets including medical, commercial, transportation, construction, industrial, heavy equipment, and government sectors. Its parts are used in shipping containers for refrigerated food, construction equipment components, consumer products, home protection items, transportation parts, and various industrial applications.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality system, a culture of low defects, and a sustainability program that recycles 100 percent of its plastic waste. VIP positions itself as a long-term partner that works with customers to optimize design, material selection, and process to reduce cost and lead time.
